The Indian Calendar of Sewell and Dikshit, an account of the Hindu luni-solar calendar, its eras and its months, with the tables for turning Indian dates into the Christian calendar (London, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Indian calendar, with tables for tor the conversion of Hindu and Muhammadan into A.D. dates, and vice versâ · Sewell, Robert, 1845-1925, Dikshit, Sankara Balkrishna, d. 1898, Schram, Robert Gustav, 1850-1923 · 1896, 344 scanned pages. Published 1896; Robert Sewell died 1925, Sankara Balkrishna Dikshit 1898 and Robert Schram 1923; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
